issue.title: axe_descriptions PNG tests use hard-coded indexes rebaselined with wrong rows after routine sort

task_type_fields.impact: Goldens lock in wrong-row selections, hiding future regressions in the descriptions panel.
task_type_fields.repro: Run the axe_descriptions snapshot tests at master: hard-coded row indexes select different routines than before 880f1f863e, and the stored goldens show the wrong selected rows.

issue.creation_reason: Found during green_master_ci_repair: 880f1f863e sorted routines alphabetically, and the axe_descriptions goldens were rebaselined with the wrong rows selected.
